[6:21AM] #Apapa
#Ajegunle
#TrafficUpdate
Excellent vehicular movements from Ijora Olopa/ high bridge via Total up bridge through RRS checking point down to Area B on both lanes, likewise returning journey from Apapa starting from Point road through Marine bridge to connect  Iganmu / Ijora Olopa is a fast moving traffic as well.

The stretch of Mobil road both inward and outward is looking good at the moment.

Boundary roundabout down to Arakan Military cantonment/ Agbomalu is a fast moving traffic for now.

Alayabiagba axis is cool and calm , likewise Baale street connecting Boundary roundabout.

Underneath the bridge Total via Navy junction connecting Naval Dockyard is good to go and also Total up bridge descending to Ijora 7'Up underneath the bridge/ roundabout is good to go.

Our Officers are on ground doing the needful.

PANOORIN: Iyan ang mensahe ni Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla sa Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) nang magsalita siya sa tradisyonal na New Year’s Call sa Camp Crame sa Quezon City.

Matatandaang ilang opisyal ng BFP ang idinawit ni Remulla sa umano’y dayaan sa bidding para sa pagbili ng mga kagamitan at iba pang katiwalian. | via Jun Veneracion/GMA Integrated News
